articles.title: Which social media stocks should your portfolio hit 'Like' on?
articles.mainIdea: Which social media stocks should your portfolio hit 'Like' on?
articles.summary: Yahoo Finance Video: Which social media stocks should your portfolio hit 'Like' on?. Boot up your laptop and hit "Post" because Yahoo Finance is taking a look at how social media stocks are faring in 2026. Shares of Facebook and Instagram parent company Meta Platforms (META) are already down 5% year-to-date in the new year. Suncoast Equity managing director and co-portfolio manager Eric Lynch and Yahoo Finance Senior Reporters Brooke DiPalma and Ines Ferré discuss Meta's stock declines while also commenting on the market performance of Pinterest (PINS) and Reddit (RDDT). To watch more expert insights and analysis on the latest market action, check out more Opening Bid. Related tickers mentioned: GOOG, META, PINS, RDDT.
